methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched directly via WebFetch on 2026-06-18 for all seven vendors (marker.io/pricing, bugherd.com/pricing, userback.io/pricing, ruttl.com/pricing, jam.dev/pricing, usersnap.com/pricing, zipboard.co/pricing) plus vendor security/privacy pages for compliance. Prices are USD billed monthly unless a plan is explicitly per-seat. Where a plan is 'contact sales' / enterprise with no published price, monthlyUsd is null. CRITICAL CORRECTION: Usersnap's official pricing page renders prices in EURO and does NOT display machine-readable USD figures; the draft's USD prices ($49/$109/$199/$319) could not be verified on the official page and are contradicted by third-party aggregators (Capterra lists Startup $99 / Company $189 / Premium $329 under different plan names). Per a strict no-guess policy, all unverifiable Usersnap paid prices are set to null. Usersnap's free offering is a TRIAL (ends after 20 feedback items; accounts deactivated after 90 days), not a forever-free plan. Ruttl's annual per-seat price is not published and is omitted rather than estimated. All accessedAt = 2026-06-18.
